::: {.obsidian-idp}

State the purpose of the plan in one paragraph. Name the period it
covers and the overall development goal.

# Development goals

List the goals for the period. Make each goal specific and
measurable.

# Actions

For each goal, state the actions, the support needed, and the
target date. Use a table.

| Goal | Action | Support | Target date |
|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| Example goal | Example action | Example support | 2026-12-01 |

# Review

State how the organisation will review the plan. Name the review
dates and the reviewer.

# Sign-off

Record the sign-off by the employee and the manager, with dates.
